entries.title: Manor Lords
entries.definitive_edition: Manor Lords on Windows PC Early Access, pending 1.0

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Manor Lords is currently a Windows PC Early Access release, making PC the only sourced playable route. The Xbox version has been discussed as a future route, but there is no sourced released console version as of June 23, 2026.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Early Access version through Steam, GOG, Epic, Microsoft Store, or PC Game Pass. Re-check the recommendation when version 1.0 or a console release is formally available.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is not a final/definitive 1.0 release yet. Future console and full-release versions should be reassessed when they are publicly available.
